suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53571 (Vite dev-server server.fs.deny bypass on Windows, NTFS ADS / 8.3 short names): vite@5.4.21 arrives transitively via vitepress@1.6.4 (range ^5.4.14), which is docs tooling only — never shipped in any artifact, never executed outside local `npm run docs:*` on the maintainer machine. No 5.x fix exists (fixed in 6.4.3 / 7.3.5 / 8.0.16); forcing vite 6 under vitepress 1.6 breaks the docs build. Exposure requires a local network attacker plus sensitive files next to a docs dev server: accepted residual risk. Re-evaluate when vitepress supports vite >= 6.4.3 (then drop this).

GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff (same Windows server.fs.deny bypass family as CVE-2026-53571, NVD CVSS >= 8 per Dependency-Check 12.1.0): same package (vite@5.4.21 via vitepress@1.6.4), same docs-tooling-only exposure, same residual-risk acceptance and re-evaluation condition. Suppressed separately because the scanner tracks the NVD and GHSA identifiers independently.
